A first-month checklist for new starters, shown as a board they move tasks across, run entirely from SharePoint lists.

**To install:** download `react-onboarding.sppkg` below and upload it to your SharePoint app catalog. Then add the **Onboarding checklist** web part to a page, and have a site owner click **Set up onboarding**.

**You need:**

- **A SharePoint Administrator** to upload the package to the app catalog.
- **A site owner** to add the web part and run setup.

There's nothing to approve and no email is sent, so it doesn't ask for any extra permissions.

Full guide: see the [README](https://github.com/tom-daly/react-onboarding#readme).
